name: SecureCrypt
subtitle: File encryption & decryption
summary: A C++17 file-encryption application using libsodium, with a menu-driven interface, local accounts, and key import and export.
overview: SecureCrypt is the portfolio name for the supplied SecureEncrypt source project. Its code separates account handling, binary file I/O, cryptographic operations, and the application menu into dedicated classes.
current_state: C++ source, headers, build files, and a README were supplied. The source uses libsodium’s ChaCha20-Poly1305 API. This portfolio review does not establish a reproducible build or a security audit.
highlights: C++17 source organized into User, FileHandler, CryptoManager, and SystemController classes.
File encryption and decryption, key generation, and key-file import/export.
CMake and Makefile build definitions in the supplied source.
next_focus: Verify the build and review authentication, key handling, file-format integrity, and platform behavior before making production-security claims.
